summary: Implemented Console.out in rich/console.py (placed after print; joins str(obj) with sep, then calls self.print once with emoji=False, markup=False, no_wrap=True, overflow="ignore", crop=False, passing end, style, highlight through; highlight defaults to True). Added "Added Console.out" under the Unreleased Added list in CHANGELOG.md. Added a "Low level output" section after Logging in docs/source/console.rst. Added RenderHook to the test imports and new tests in tests/test_console.py: test_out, test_out_returns_none, test_out_markup, test_out_emoji, test_out_containers_not_pretty_printed, test_out_no_crop, test_out_style, test_out_highlight, test_out_render_hook. Existing tests unchanged. Nothing was run and nothing was committed, per instructions; all changes were verified by reading only.
